title: Month 2, Week 1 (Dec 6 – Dec 12, 2026): Fibroblastic/Myofibroblastic, Myxoid, Muscle & Vascular Soft Tissue + Oral/Larynx

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall Adipocytic tumors (Spindle cell lipoma RB1 loss/CD34+ vs. ALT/WDLPS & DDLPS MDM2/CDK4 amp vs. Myxoid liposarcoma FUS/EWSR1::DDIT3).
Reading (75m): WHO Soft Tissue & Bone 5th Ed. — Fibroblastic/Myofibroblastic I: Nodular Fasciitis (USP6), Myositis Ossificans (zonal phenomenon, USP6), Elastofibroma, Fibroma of Tendon Sheath, Desmoplastic Fibroblastoma (FOSL1), & Mammary-type Myofibroblastoma (RB1 loss).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Nodular fasciitis tissue-culture myofibroblasts, Myositis ossificans zonation, Elastofibroma elastic globes, Spindle cell lipoma, Myxoid liposarcoma chicken-wire vessels).
QBank (30m): 15 Adipocytic & Reactive Myofibroblastic MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log 4-Domain SOE entry on Myositis Ossificans vs. Extraskeletal Osteosarcoma (peripheral lamellar bone maturation in MO vs. reverse zonation in osteosarcoma + X-ray correlation).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Blank-sheet recall of USP6-rearranged lesions (Nodular fasciitis, Myositis ossificans, Cranial fasciitis, Primary ABC, Cellular fibroma of tendon sheath).
Reading (75m): WHO 5th Ed. — Fibroblastic II: Palmar/Plantar Fibromatosis, Desmoid Fibromatosis (CTNNB1 or APC, nuclear β-catenin+), Solitary Fibrous Tumor (NAB2::STAT6, STAT6+ & risk model), DFSP (COL1A1::PDGFB, CD34+, honeycomb fat infiltration), & IMT (ALK/ROS1/NTRK3).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Desmoid sweeping fascicles, SFT staghorn vessels, DFSP storiform/honeycomb fat, IMT, CNS spaced slide).
QBank (20m): 15 Fibroblastic/SFT MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 1 & log the WHO SFT Metastatic Risk Model (Age ≥55y, Size <5/5–10/10–15/≥15 cm, Mitoses ≥4/10 HPF, Necrosis ≥10%).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Write out the CD34+ Spindle Cell Tumor differential (SFT, DFSP, Spindle cell lipoma, GIST, Neurofibroma, Epithelioid sarcoma) with confirmatory IHC.
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Virtual Slides: 6 Soft Tissue spindle/adipocytic slides (3m/case) + 4 Cervical Pap smears (Bethesda 2015: NILM/infections, ASC-US, LSIL, HSIL @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 Soft Tissue & Cervical Cytology MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log Bethesda Cervical Cytology adequacy criteria (Liquid-based ThinPrep/SurePath ≥5,000 squamous cells; Conventional ≥8,000–12,000 cells; ≥10 endocervical/metaplastic cells for TZ).

days.b1: Secondary System — Oral Cavity, Oropharynx & Larynx (90m): WHO Head & Neck 5th Ed. — Oral Dysplasia & Proliferative Verrucous Leukoplakia; HPV-Associated vs. HPV-Independent Oropharyngeal SCC (p16 surrogate IHC rule: ≥70% diffuse strong nuclear & cytoplasmic staining; non-keratinizing basaloid morphology); Laryngeal nodules, HPV 6/11 papillomatosis, & Spindle cell SCC.
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 15 Head & Neck SCC/Larynx MCQs + 5 Spot Slides (HPV+ OPSCC, Verrucous carcinoma, Vocal cord nodule, Laryngeal chondrosarcoma, Oral granular cell tumor with pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the classic trap: Granular Cell Tumor (S100+, SOX10+, CD68+, PAS-D+) with florid Pseudoepitheliomatous Hyperplasia (PEH) on superficial tongue biopsy mimicking well-differentiated SCC!

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Recall p16 IHC positivity threshold in Oropharyngeal SCC (≥70% nuclear + cytoplasmic) and why p16 alone is NOT used outside the oropharynx (except level II/III unknown primary node).
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Soft Tissue/H&N + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls tagged Soft Tissue & Oral/Larynx).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect recall answer explanations.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Add missed Soft Tissue & Head/Neck recall traps into your 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 1 Soft Tissue & Head/Neck SOE entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 1 of Month 2 to GitHub.

days.b1: Primary System Deep Dive — Myxoid, Smooth/Skeletal Muscle & Vascular Soft Tissue Tumors (2.5h): WHO 5th Ed. — Low-Grade Fibromyxoid Sarcoma (Evans tumor; FUS::CREB3L2, MUC4+), Sclerosing Epithelioid Fibrosarcoma (MUC4+), Myxofibrosarcoma (curvilinear vessels), Intramuscular Myxoma (GNAS), Aggressive Angiomyxoma (HMGA2+, ER/PR+), Leiomyosarcoma, Rhabdomyosarcoma (Embryonal, Alveolar PAX3/7::FOXO1, Spindle cell/sclerosing MYOD1 L122R), & Vascular Tumors (Kaposi HHV8+, EHE WWTR1::CAMTA1, Angiosarcoma MYC amp).
days.b2: Slides & QBank (90m): 12 Soft Tissue Spot Slides @ 3m/case (LGFMS, Myxofibrosarcoma, Embryonal/Alveolar RMS, LMS, Kaposi sarcoma, EHE blister cells, Angiosarcoma, Glomus tumor) + 25 Soft Tissue MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Study One-Pager 1 & record a 3-min spoken SOE response on a Deep Thigh Myxoid Mass differential (Myxoid LPS vs. LGFMS vs. Myxofibrosarcoma vs. Intramuscular myxoma).
